title: Tavi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: She was Rabbi Chiyya’s daughter, born a twin with her sister Pazi, as in [Yevamot 65b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.65b.18). Hyman says he has already explained in the entry Rabbi Chiyya that she was betrothed to the son of our holy Rabbi and died before the wedding.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The sentence begins on 65b and [continues at the top of 66a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.66a.1). It names Pazi and Tavi (טוי) as sisters in the account of Rabbi Chiyya and Yehudit.
The betrothal and death are reported by Hyman from his separate entry on Rabbi Chiyya.
